Mod.Name: 机核协议：伪人飞升 / Mechcore Protocol: Aug Ascension
Mod.Author: NicoKobo
Mod.Description:
整合合成制造、模组矩阵与伪人：机械飞升，包含工业设备、义体、模组成长、Nico 工坊和失物招领剧情。需要 NicoKobo Forge；食品加工为可选联动。
Combines synthesis manufacturing, Module Matrix and Aug: Mechanical Ascension, including industrial equipment, cybernetics, module growth, Nico Workshop and the Lost and Found story. Requires NicoKobo Forge; Food Processing is optional.
